title: Clima ANM: analize climatice pe cubul Zarr anm-daily-grids (EOCube.ro)
description:
Clima ANM is a portable, local program with a browser interface for climate analyses on the daily 1 km gridded data of the Romanian National Meteorological Administration (ANM), 1961–present, served as the Zarr data cube anm-daily-grids by EOCube.ro.

It computes maps, anomalies, trends with significance tests, ETCCDI and percentile-based indices, SPI/SPEI, record-breaking (superlative) analyses and zonal statistics, checks the integrity of the cube (missing or unwritten chunks are treated as missing data, not as zero), and writes reproducible, documented outputs: COG GeoTIFF (including per-year series for animation), PNG, GeoPackage, CSV and a visual HTML sheet for every run. The interface includes an interactive map with A|B comparison, hillshade relief, year animation with video export and a presentation mode.

It runs without administrator rights or a prior Python installation: a locked conda-forge environment (pixi) is installed inside the program folder. Interface and documentation in Romanian. Built for teaching GIS and climatology at the University of Bucharest.

Code: MIT. Documentation: CC BY 4.0. Data analysed (not included): ANM / MeteoRomania, processing UVT – EOCube.Ro, CC BY 4.0. Included relief: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (© DLR e.V. 2010–2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014–2018, provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA).
